entities.name: Sign Pollution
entities.description: Issues related to visual pollution caused by excessive or poorly regulated signage, including billboards and large advertisements, impacting city aesthetics and environment.

entities.name: Signage Importance
entities.description: The significance of signage in urban areas for building identification, commercial real estate, and navigation, emphasizing the role of signs in city functionality and business visibility.

entities.name: Urban Regulations
entities.description: Regulations and policies governing the use, size, placement, and type of signage within the city to ensure safety, aesthetics, and compliance with city standards.
